description_en: Call this operation to obtain a preview or download URL for a recording file based on its name
description_zh: 通过本接口，可以根据录音文件名获取录音试听或下载地址
name: CloudGetRecordUrl

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The recording type. If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically determines the type from the `RecordFile` name. Valid values: `record` (a standard recording), `voicemail` (a voicemail), `tsi` (a color ringback tone used for a preview outbound call to a mobile number that goes unanswered when recording status detection is enabled), `rasr` (a customer-side recording for a voice bot), `transfer` (a transfer), `consult` (a consult), and `threeway` (a three-way call)
parameters.help_zh: 录音类型，不填可根据 recordFile 解析；record:录音voicemail:留言tsi:彩铃、当开启号码录音状态识别，发起预览外呼，客户号码是手机且客户未接听时返回该地址 rasr:语音机器人客户侧录音 transfer:转接consult:咨询threeway:三方
parameters.name: record_type

parameters.help_en: The recording file type. Valid values: `0` for MP3 (default) and `1` for WAV
parameters.help_zh: 录音文件类型；取值说明：0为mp3，1为wav，默认为mp3类型
parameters.name: record_format

parameters.help_en: The call type. This parameter is required to retrieve `customer-side` or `agent-side` recordings when `separate-channel recording` is enabled. It is effective only when `RecordFormat` is set to `1` (WAV) and is ignored if `RecordFormat` is set to `0` (MP3). Valid values: `1` (inbound call), `2` (Webcall), `4` (preview outbound call), and `5` (predictive outbound call)
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫类型；说明：开启分线录音时，获取客户侧或座席侧录音需要，recordFormat=1时有效，recordFormat=0时忽略。取值范围：1,2,4,5（数字含义：呼入,webcall,预览外呼,预测外呼）
parameters.name: call_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies the recording side for a `separate-channel recording`. This parameter is required to retrieve `customer-side` or `agent-side` recordings when `separate-channel recording` is enabled. It is effective only when `RecordFormat` is set to `1` (WAV) and is ignored if `RecordFormat` is set to `0` (MP3). If you specify this parameter, `CallType` is also required. Valid values: `1` (customer side) and `2` (agent side)
parameters.help_zh: 分线录音侧；说明：开启分线录音时，获取客户侧或座席侧录音需要，recordFormat=1时有效，recordFormat=0时忽略。取值范围：1,2 (数字含义：客户侧，座席侧)recordSide不为空时，callType必选
parameters.name: record_side

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to generate a download link. Set this to `1` for a download URL. If you set this to `0` or leave it empty, a preview URL is generated
parameters.help_zh: 是否下载；１为下载，空或０表示试听
parameters.name: download
